result.title: From the ELBO to Maximum Likelihood: Convergence of Variational Autoencoders for Nonlinear Mixed-Effects Modeling
result.summary: Nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) models are the central statistical models of pharmacometrics, where they support dose selection, individualized dosing and regulatory decisions in drug development. Statistically, NLME modeling is a marginalized likelihood problem. Variational autoencoders (VAEs) solve such problems with a neural network encoder that amortizes the approximation of the intractable posterior distribution, and allow the integration of AI components into NLME modeling. This paper provides the convergence analysis of the VAE-NLME algorithm. First, its version for the evidence lower bound (ELBO) is proven to converge almost surely to the set of stationary points of the ELBO, without assuming that the encoder is trained exactly. Second, the final VAE-NLME algorithm trains the encoder on the ELBO by gradient-based optimization and uses it as proposal for importance-weighted sufficient statistics. It converges almost surely to the set of stationary points of the marginal log-likelihood, without any assumption on the training of the encoder. Thus, it combines the fast gradient-based training of VAEs with the limit of maximum likelihood estimation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对用于非线性混合效应模型的 VAE 算法作收敛性分析：先证明 ELBO 版本几乎必然收敛到 ELBO 的驻点，再证明将训练好的编码器作为重要性加权充分统计量的提议分布时，算法几乎必然收敛到边际似然（MLE）的驻点。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「摊销后验 + 重要性加权修正」的思路可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的提议与偏差校正、以及在无法精确推断时如何监督内部状态提供概念线索，但领域相隔较远，需核查可迁移性。
